forge_threads_scope_consistency_check.name: forge_threads_scope_consistency_check
forge_threads_scope_consistency_check.value:
("forge_threads"."scope" = 'org' AND "forge_threads"."project_id" IS NULL AND "forge_threads"."run_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("forge_threads"."scope" = 'project' AND "forge_threads"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "forge_threads"."run_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("forge_threads"."scope" = 'run' AND "forge_threads"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "forge_threads"."run_id" IS NOT NULL)

inbox_sources_attention_check.name: inbox_sources_attention_check
inbox_sources_attention_check.value:
(
        "inbox_sources"."state" = 'active'
        AND "inbox_sources"."attention_code" IS NULL
        AND "inbox_sources"."attention_message" IS NULL
        AND "inbox_sources"."attention_observed_at" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "inbox_sources"."state" = 'needs_attention'
        AND "inbox_sources"."enabled" = 'false'
        AND "inbox_sources"."attention_code" IN ('unsupported_provider','invalid_config','credential_unavailable','authority_unavailable','resource_unavailable')
        AND "inbox_sources"."attention_message" IS NOT NULL
        AND "inbox_sources"."attention_observed_at" IS NOT NULL
      )

manual_deploy_attestations_confirmation_.name: manual_deploy_attestations_confirmation_shape_check
manual_deploy_attestations_confirmation_.value:
("manual_deploy_attestations"."state" = 'pending_manual_confirmation' AND "manual_deploy_attestations"."confirmed_at" IS NULL AND "manual_deploy_attestations"."confirmed_by" IS NULL)
          OR ("manual_deploy_attestations"."state" = 'confirmed' AND "manual_deploy_attestations"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "manual_deploy_attestations"."confirmed_by" IS NOT NULL)

notification_targets_scope_user_check.name: notification_targets_scope_user_check
notification_targets_scope_user_check.value: ("notification_targets"."scope" = 'org' AND "notification_targets"."user_id" IS NULL) OR ("notification_targets"."scope" = 'user' AND "notification_targets"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)

personas_scope_project_check.name: personas_scope_project_check
personas_scope_project_check.value: ("personas"."scope" = 'org' AND "personas"."project_id" IS NULL) OR ("personas"."scope" = 'project' AND "personas"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)

org_integration_connection_operations_re.name: org_integration_connection_operations_reservation_check
org_integration_connection_operations_re.value: "org_integration_connection_operations"."stage" NOT IN ('finalizing','activate_pending','completed') OR ("org_integration_connection_operations"."verification_fingerprint" IS NOT NULL AND "org_integration_connection_operations"."verified_principal" IS NOT NULL AND "org_integration_connection_operations"."verified_auth_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "org_integration_connection_operations"."verified_scopes" IS NOT NULL AND "org_integration_connection_operations"."reserved_connection_id" IS NOT NULL AND "org_integration_connection_operations"."reserved_credential_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "org_integration_connection_operations"."target_auth_generation" IS NOT NULL AND "org_integration_connection_operations"."target_grant_id" IS NOT NULL AND "org_integration_connection_operations"."target_grant_generation" IS NOT NULL AND "org_integration_connection_operations"."reserved_capabilities" IS NOT NULL AND "org_integration_connection_operations"."reserved_operations" IS NOT NULL AND "org_integration_connection_operations"."reserved_policy_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "org_integration_connection_operations"."reserved_consent_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "org_integration_connection_operations"."reserved_consented_at" IS NOT NULL)

integration_requirements_superseded_chec.name: integration_requirements_superseded_check
integration_requirements_superseded_chec.value: ("integration_requirements"."status" = 'superseded' AND "integration_requirements"."superseded_by" IS NOT NULL) OR ("integration_requirements"."status" <> 'superseded' AND "integration_requirements"."superseded_by" IS NULL)

delivery_runs_claim_check.name: delivery_runs_claim_check
delivery_runs_claim_check.value: ("delivery_runs"."claim_owner" IS NULL AND "delivery_runs"."claim_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("delivery_runs"."claim_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "delivery_runs"."claim_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

delivery_runs_completed_check.name: delivery_runs_completed_check
delivery_runs_completed_check.value: ("delivery_runs"."status" = 'completed' AND "delivery_runs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("delivery_runs"."status" <> 'completed' AND "delivery_runs"."completed_at" IS NULL)

delivery_stage_attempts_claim_check.name: delivery_stage_attempts_claim_check
delivery_stage_attempts_claim_check.value: ("delivery_stage_attempts"."claim_owner" IS NULL AND "delivery_stage_attempts"."claim_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("delivery_stage_attempts"."claim_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "delivery_stage_attempts"."claim_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

integration_reconciliations_binding_gene.name: integration_reconciliations_binding_generation_check
integration_reconciliations_binding_gene.value: ("integration_reconciliations"."binding_id" IS NULL AND "integration_reconciliations"."binding_generation" IS NULL) OR ("integration_reconciliations"."binding_id" IS NOT NULL AND "integration_reconciliations"."binding_generation" >= 1)

integration_reconciliations_claim_check.name: integration_reconciliations_claim_check
integration_reconciliations_claim_check.value: ("integration_reconciliations"."claim_owner" IS NULL AND "integration_reconciliations"."claim_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("integration_reconciliations"."claim_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "integration_reconciliations"."claim_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

integration_resource_snapshots_binding_g.name: integration_resource_snapshots_binding_generation_check
integration_resource_snapshots_binding_g.value: ("integration_resource_snapshots"."binding_id" IS NULL AND "integration_resource_snapshots"."binding_generation" IS NULL) OR ("integration_resource_snapshots"."binding_id" IS NOT NULL AND "integration_resource_snapshots"."binding_generation" >= 1)

project_app_env_value_xor_check.name: project_app_env_value_xor_check
project_app_env_value_xor_check.value: ("project_app_env"."value_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "project_app_env"."plain_value" IS NULL) OR ("project_app_env"."value_ref" IS NULL AND "project_app_env"."plain_value" IS NOT NULL)

project_app_env_binding_check.name: project_app_env_binding_check
project_app_env_binding_check.value: ("project_app_env"."source" = 'byo' AND "project_app_env"."binding_id" IS NULL AND "project_app_env"."binding_generation" IS NULL) OR ("project_app_env"."source" = 'provisioned' AND "project_app_env"."binding_id" IS NOT NULL AND "project_app_env"."binding_generation" >= 1 AND "project_app_env"."environment" IN ('test','preview','production'))

project_app_env_secret_generation_check.name: project_app_env_secret_generation_check
project_app_env_secret_generation_check.value: ("project_app_env"."value_ref" IS NULL AND "project_app_env"."secret_generation" IS NULL) OR ("project_app_env"."value_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "project_app_env"."secret_generation" >= 1)

project_derivations_completed_check.name: project_derivations_completed_check
project_derivations_completed_check.value: ("project_derivations"."status" IN ('succeeded','failed','compensated') AND "project_derivations"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("project_derivations"."status" IN ('pending','in_progress') AND "project_derivations"."completed_at" IS NULL)
